A WIZARD’S JOURNEY BEGINS WITH A SINGLE PIXEL.Made for wandering. Built for your phone. ↗

Welcome to the grove.

Choose an art style, then collect all five glowing moonstones. Move with the arrow pad on your phone, or WASD / arrow keys on a keyboard.

Tap Cast (or press Space) to send a spell toward the nearest moonstone. Spells collect stones too! Your favorite style stays saved in this browser.

This is a small RPG art prototype. Pick the direction you like and we can build the next adventure around it.
